mapper.select:
SELECT b.*, c.name AS category_name FROM bill b JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY b.date DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bill (user_id, amount, type, category_id, date, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{categoryId}, #{date}, #{remark})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bill WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
